title: Ukraine hits Kerch bridge between Russia and occupied Crimea
summary_full: Traffic temporarily restricted on key connection after bridge targeted during overnight drone barrage by UkraineUkraine has hit the Kerch bridge connecting occupied Crimea with Russia, in a symbolic blow that temporarily paralysed road traffic and left thousands of drivers stranded.A Ukrainian kamikaze drone crashed into one of the bridge’s arches at 5.38am local time, local channels reported. Earlier drones could be heard buzzing above the structure, as Russian air defence units opened fire. Continue reading...
